title: Impulse-to-Peak-Output Norm Optimal State-Feedback Control of Linear PDEs
summary: Impulse-to-peak response (I2P) analysis for state-space ordinary differential equation (ODE) systems is a well-studied classical problem. However, the techniques employed for I2P optimal control of ODEs have not been extended to partial differential equation (PDE) systems due to the lack of a universal transfer function and state-space representation.
